brand_identity.positioning: Largest Trade Partner for Philips Smart Locks in Australia

rules: Headings MUST NEVER use generic Inter font. Rotate through Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans.
Overlines/labels MUST use uppercase JetBrains Mono with tracking-[0.2em].

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, e.g., data-testid='nav-quote-cart-button', data-testid='product-filter-face', data-testid='request-trade-pricing-button', data-testid='enquiry-form-submit-button'
accessibility_rules: All images must have meaningful alt descriptions
Buttons must have discernible text or aria-label
Modals must trap focus and respond to Escape key

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a pure React JS frontend application with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Ensure the app is fully static and client-side ready for GitHub Pages hosting.
Do NOT show any retail prices anywhere. Replace price tags with 'Request for Price' or 'Contact for Trade Pricing'.
Include a functional Quote / Enquiry Cart state allowing visitors to add locks (DDL902, DDL801, DDL720-5HWS, DDL720-MVP-17HWS) and generate a pre-filled email enquiry to info@mindmaze.au.
Highlight Mindmaze prominently as the 'Largest Trade Partner for Philips Smart Locks in Australia' with dedicated messaging for builders and trades.
Strictly follow unlock method listings: DDL902 must feature 3D Face, Palm, Fingerprint, PIN, Key Tag, Mechanical Key, App, and Video Doorbell.
Ensure DDL720-5HWS and DDL720-MVP-17HWS are clearly represented in Grey finish only.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid standard white/light grey templates. Use dark obsidian surfaces with soft amber/gold glows, high contrast, rich typography, and smooth micro-interactions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_ids: Every interactive button, link, tab, filter, and input MUST contain data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Never use transition: all globally. Specify transition-colors or transition-transform for interactive elements.
